mapper.sql: SELECT s.id, s.route_id, s.ship_id, s.depart_time, s.arrive_time, s.price, s.status, s.sold_count, s.deleted, r.route_name, r.depart_port, r.arrive_port, sh.ship_name, sh.ship_type, sh.total_seats, (sh.total_seats - s.sold_count) AS remaining_seats FROM schedule s JOIN route r ON s.route_id = r.id JOIN ship sh ON s.ship_id = sh.id
mapper.select: SELECT id, route_id, ship_id, depart_time, arrive_time, price, status, sold_count, deleted FROM schedule WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedule (route_id, ship_id, depart_time, arrive_time, price, status) VALUES (#{routeId}, #{shipId}, #{departTime}, #{arriveTime}, #{price}, #{status})

INSERT INTO schedule (route_id, ship_id, depart_time, arrive_time, price, status) VALUES
(#{s.routeId}, #{s.shipId}, #{s.departTime}, #{s.arriveTime}, #{s.price}, #{s.status})
mapper.update: UPDATE schedule SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE schedule SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE schedule SET sold_count = sold_count + #{count} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE schedule SET sold_count = GREATEST(sold_count - #{count}, 0) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND status IN ('UNPAID','PAID','CHECKED')
SELECT id, route_id, ship_id, depart_time, arrive_time, price, status, sold_count, deleted FROM schedule WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'DEPARTED' AND arrive_time < NOW()
